---
title: "Quiz: Folders and paths"
---

[Lecture](../lectures/02-folders-computers/lec.qmd) · [Exercises](02-folders-computers.qmd)

Try each question before opening its hint or answer.

---

**Q1.** In the course project, `data` and `reports` are both directly inside `introcomputing-course`. Is `reports` inside `data`? What is their parent folder?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Hint"}
Draw the tree with indentation.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Answer"}
No, they are neighbours. Their parent is the project folder, `introcomputing-course`.
:::

---

**Q2.** Which of these paths is absolute and which is relative: `/Users/anna/Documents/introcomputing-course/data/seedlings.csv` and `data/seedlings.csv`?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Hint"}
Where does each path start?
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Answer"}
The first is absolute: it starts at the top of the disk (`/`). The second is relative: it starts from an agreed folder, here the project folder.
:::

---

**Q3.** From the project folder, `data/seedlings.csv` finds the measurements. From inside `reports`, where does the same path point?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Hint"}
A relative path starts from the current folder.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Answer"}
To a `data` folder inside `reports`, which does not exist. Go up to the project folder first (written `../data/seedlings.csv` from `reports`).
:::

---

**Q4.** Anna's R code reads `C:\Users\anna\Documents\introcomputing-course\data\seedlings.csv`. Ben runs it on his laptop. What happens, and what should Anna write instead?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Hint"}
Which part of the path is specific to Anna's laptop?
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Answer"}
It fails, because Ben's laptop has no folder `C:\Users\anna`. Anna should write the relative path `data/seedlings.csv`, which works for anyone who opens the project folder.
:::

---

**Q5.** You move the folder `practice/map-a` into `practice/map-b`. Does `note.txt` inside it change? What is its new path from the project folder?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Hint"}
Compare the contents of the file with its location.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Answer"}
The contents stay the same; only the location changes. The new path is `practice/map-b/map-a/note.txt`.
:::

---

**Q6.** You add a sentence to a note, close the editor and choose **Don't save**. What is in the file when you reopen it?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Hint"}
Where does unsaved text live?
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Answer"}
The last saved version, without the new sentence. Unsaved text lives in working memory and disappears when the program closes; saved text is on disk.
:::
